scope: Source review; local selected Java tests and frontend auth tests. No Staging, live provider, DAST or CVE audit.

java_validation.scope: Security and SMS suites selected from the full backend run, including the opt-in PostgreSQL MOCK worker integration. Full suite result is in full-backend-summary.json.
java_validation.limitation: Local JDK25 unavailable; rerun unchanged pom with JDK25 in CI before release.

limited_secret_pattern_scan.limitations: Only current textual source/configuration; no Git history, binaries, Office documents, runtime environment or entropy analysis. No match does not prove absence of secrets.

hash_line_endings: source_sha256 hashes local bytes; source_sha256_lf normalizes CRLF to LF for comparison with Git text blobs.
